text:
emily: Starting staged rollout for release v3.8.2 -> shifting 10% canary in us-east. Change window 21:00-22:00 PT.

deploybot: Deploy initiated: commit abc1234 -> redwood/inference:v3.8.2. Traffic plan: 0% -> 10% (canary).

raj: I’ll watch KV cache eviction patterns + memory across the canary pods. Attaching traces.

ops_lead: Please avoid unrelated infra changes during this window. If latency or errors spike, call rollback.

maria: Release notes updated with short changelog and observability checklist: https://rbwrd.xyz/rn/v3.8.2

dave: Reminder: rollback triggers: >=1.0% 5xx OR sustained p95 tail +20% for 10m. Keep eyes on those.

emily: Agreed. Hold on ramp for 20m after the 10% shift so QA can run smoke.

deploybot: Traffic shifted to 10% canary @ 1711111120. Auto-ramp disabled unless ops says go.

sre-bot: ALERT: us-east canary p95 increased +12% vs baseline, small RTT tail observed. (sig: latency-tail)

emily: Noted — any errors or stacktraces?

raj: No spike in 5xx yet. Logs show more long-sequence requests with larger context lengths, CPU kernel spiking on generation. p95 jump correlates with those.

maria: Adding note to release: 'Investigation: p95 tail increase during canary' :mag:

dave: Proposal: soft-pause — keep traffic at 10% and stop further ramp. No immediate rollback unless error thresholds are crossed.

ops_lead: Quick vote: soft-pause for now, collect traces for 30m. If not improving, rollback in 30m.

emily: Fine by me. I’ll kick off targeted eval run against canary using the "billing_invoices" smoke prompts.

deploybot: Canary pinned at 10%. Auto-ramp disabled.

sre-bot: Checkpoint: metric snapshot saved -> https://rbwrd.xyz/metrics/snap/1711111125

raj: I’ll try a KV prefetch tweak on one canary replica to see if the tail drops. Will report back in ~7m.

maria: Updating #release-dashboard and pinging stakeholders (PM and CS).

dave: +1 to rollback if tail persists after the config tweak and QA fails.

emily: Paging @sre-oncall for visibility.

sre-bot: Oncall paged: @sre-oncall

emily: We’ll reconvene in 15m. If there's no improvement within 30m, ops will trigger rollback to v3.8.1.

end.
